text:
sam: Heads up — deploybot just promoted engine build `eng-v2.3.0-abi12` to the night bucket. Perf team noticed a subtle regression in quant kernels in staging. Do we pin or let the canary run?

deploy-bot: preflight: smoke OK on 92% staging workers. Telemetry: tail latency +12% on quant-matmul (INT8) for seq>2048. Canary rollout: 5% traffic -> samples flowing.

nisha: What's our concrete rollback criteria? e.g., sustained latency +10% for 3 windows or error spike? Need a metric to act on.

maria: Quick note from perf — regression is isolated to INT8 matmul for long contexts. seq<=1024 looks fine; seq>=2048 shows the bump.

ryan: Proposal: rollback if either (a) latency 95th increases >10% for 3 consecutive 5m windows OR (b) errors >0.1% absolute. Also add a sticky-pin TTL of 30m when pinned so ops can triage.

ben: +1. Add that we only pin the new kernel variant and keep v11 as fallback for high-SLA customers. Also request a release-note blurb: "quant kernel perf regression for long contexts".

sam: Can we scope the pin to customer subsets? Prefer to route high-SLA traffic to v11 and let general pool continue canary at 5%.

maria: Deploybot supports per-engine and per-customer pins. I can patch routing policy `route::engine_pin(v11)` for the high-sla set if you approve.

nisha: SRE approves. Please also create a ticket to track follow-up: INF-3489 and include rollback runbook. Manual override to unpin from Console required.

deploy-bot: routing change applied -> pinned fallback to `eng-v11` for high-sla set (8 customers). Canary remains 5% for general pool.

ben: Sam — can you add the rollback prometheus queries and exact steps in the release note PR? I'll add the escalation steps (who to page if metric breaches).

sam: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/release-notes/PR-421 — includes rollback query, pin TTL, and contact list.

ryan: Also spinning up a targeted test: `tools/bench/quant-longseq --seq 4096 --runs 50` to validate patch candidate. Tagging @perf-team for verification.

maria: Setting up that job now. If metrics stabilize for two consecutive windows we'll unpin automatically after TTL expires.

nisha: Thanks everyone. Keep the channel updated. Note: if traffic shift >15% or error spike >0.1% we'll escalate to oncall.

sam: Will do — I'll post a quick postmortem template in INF-3489 if we need further follow-up.
